steps.name: Agree high-level direction
steps.instructions: As the main agent, discuss the request with the human. Clarify expected outcome, scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and whether this is one feature or an epic. Propose high-level decisions and an implementation direction; do not over-specify the implementation here. Show the proposed decisions and plan to the human and wait for explicit agreement before advancing. Ask only questions that need a human decision; otherwise keep making progress. Before approval, do not create a task group, tasks, or KOS artifacts. If approval is withheld or a blocker remains, stay on this step and resume the discussion rather than asserting agreement.

steps.name: Record brief and plan work
steps.instructions: As the main agent, confirm that the human explicitly agreed to the high-level decisions and plan in the preceding step. Only after that agreement, save requirements, specification, and implementation_plan as high-level Markdown artifacts; record approved choices and acceptance criteria, leaving detailed design and implementation planning to each execution task. Create at least one planned task using the shared KOS Execution workflow. For an epic, create one epic group and place the new tasks in it. Create every dependent task atomically with blocked_by_ids including this brief task ID so no unfinished work becomes ready before the brief completes; add other explicit dependencies as needed. Check the new tasks, workflow IDs, group and blockers. Save planning_report listing all created task IDs, relationships, and the approved plan. If anything fails, inspect existing records and reconcile without duplicating tasks; stay on this step until the results are complete. Then complete the brief under its active claim; do not claim the dependent work before completion.
